propositions: Plan reviews must track a compiled phase state (planning or execution) maintained by the reducer, derived from winning status transitions: in_progress→execution, open→planning, others preserve current; losing fork events and backward-compat snapshots do not update phase.

Execution-phase reviews apply a fixed 0.80 priority-floor blocking threshold; planning reviews use default criteria thresholds; manifest and sidecar schemas persist phase and floor as v2 JSON with exact syntax rules and parse through dedicated validators.

Pre-feature snapshots and legacy attestations without phase fields bootstrap planning for open/idea status and execution for all other known statuses, emitting one INFO event and activating lazily via reducer cache versioning without appending ticket events.

Phase compatibility validation returns incompatible/malformed/compatible status: planning state accepts planning/legacy/execution attestations; execution state accepts planning/legacy but only execution floor≥0.80, rejecting lower floors as incompatible and syntax errors as malformed.

Signing transactions capture an immutable initial generation before LLM/probe, retry at most three times only on unstable tracker HEAD, verify generation equality under lock, and emit structured WARN/ERROR for retry/stale/abort outcomes without writing on failure.

Rollback pauses compaction and re-sign during downgrade window to preserve phase fields in snapshots; old reducers lose phase precision during re-reduction but forward upgrade reboots it from compiled status per documented loss window.
